description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git operations related to history culling and revision listing. It sets up a repository state with commits, branches, and merges, then runs specific 'git rev-list' commands to verify behaviors. It primarily contains setup commands, test expectations, and Git commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the given message.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with provided commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test script.
